reasons: The retained What's On listing carries an explicit, source-tagged genre field ('fs-cmsfilter-field="genre"') on every production, and all three currently-listed productions in the retained excerpt ('Tartuffe (Remixed)', 'Speculations...', 'What We Talk About When We Talk About Anne Frank') are each tagged genre 'Theatre' — none is tagged 'Music'.
